column1: # Bangla curriculum synonym classes — PLAN.md task T6b (Tier A: hand-authored).
# Tier A cannot induce these from FastText neighbours, so they are written by
# hand for the curriculum terms that actually matter.  Tier B (X3) adds
# distributionally-induced candidates on top, and reports the precision of BOTH
# against the same probe set — which turns "does distributional induction beat a
# hand list?" into a measured question instead of an assumption.
# `reviewed=1` means a human checked the pair.  Unreviewed pairs are flagged and
# EXCLUDED from headline metrics (PLAN.md §7.4) — embedding neighbourhoods put
# antonyms and co-hyponyms close together, so an unvetted list quietly turns
# Symmetry is implied: the loader closes each class under symmetry+transitivity.
